## Overview

Runs Qwen4Exp (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next) routed experts on the DeepGEMM MegaMoE backend (`--kernel-config '{"moe_backend":"deep_gemm_mega_moe"}'`, built on `DeepGemmMegaMoEExperts` from #61538). The 128x128 block-FP8 experts of the official checkpoint are requantized at load time to MXFP8 (default) or MXFP4 (`--quantization-config '{"moe":"mxfp4"}'`).

## Claims

- Qwen4Exp can serve with `deep_gemm_mega_moe` on Blackwell with expert parallelism (TP=1; scale out with DP).
- Accuracy: MXFP8 and MXFP4 MegaMoE both pass non-inferiority against stock FP8 on AIME25, AIME26, GPQA-Diamond and MMMU-Pro on the same vLLM commit (table below).
- B300, vs the default MoE backend on the same commit:
  - TP1 prefill throughput: +12-13% (MXFP8), +15-16% (MXFP4).
  - DEP4 decode output throughput: +13-17% (MXFP8), +23-25% (MXFP4); mean TPOT -10-13% / -18-20%.
- Weight loading: requantization adds ~10 s on a TP1 engine (58 s stock vs 67 s MXFP8 / 72 s MXFP4).
- Works with layerwise reload and chunked weight updates.

## Validation

All runs: 8x B300 SXM6 nodes, vLLM nightly `edad8b03c5` plus this patch. Checkpoint: `Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8`. A later cleanup removed comments, unreachable branches and redundant tests without changing numerics, and the unit tests were re-run on it. The branch is now rebased onto `f81a414fae`; the upstream changes in between that touch these files move EPLB replica mapping into MegaMoE staging (only active with EPLB) and change fused-shared-expert selection for the default Qwen4Exp MoE block.

### Unit tests

`pytest tests/models/qwen4_exp/test_mega_moe.py`: 10 passed (~60 s) on B300. The tests cover:
- format selection from `quantization_config`, including `ignore` and `targets`;
- requantization matching DeepGEMM's own casts;
- loading into the kernel layout on one EP rank of two, batched requantization bitwise equal to per-expert requantization;
- weight and scale arriving in separate `load_weights` calls, and the strict post-load check on an incomplete pair;
- layerwise reload replacing the experts in the original storage;
- MXFP8 and MXFP4 experts end-to-end through the MegaMoE kernel against a dequantized reference.

### Accuracy

Reasoning evals with thinking on, sampling `temperature=1.0, top_p=0.95, top_k=20`, `max_tokens=98304`, `--max-model-len 131072 --max-num-batched-tokens 8192`, real MTP3 speculative decoding (`--speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":3}'`).

Epochs per question:

| Benchmark | Epochs | MXFP4 epochs (two pooled runs) |
|---|---|---|
| AIME25 | 32 | 64 |
| AIME26 | 32 | 32 |
| GPQA-Diamond | 16 | 32 |
| MMMU-Pro | 4 | 8 |

Arms:
- Stock FP8: TP4 + EP, default MoE backend.
- MegaMoE: DP4 + EP.

Rule: paired difference vs stock over questions with a bootstrap 95% CI. The result is non-inferior if the CI lower bound is ≥ -2 pt (AIME) or -1 pt (GPQA-D, MMMU-Pro).

| Benchmark | Stock FP8 | MegaMoE MXFP8 | Δ vs stock [95% CI] | MegaMoE MXFP4 | Δ vs stock [95% CI] |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AIME25 | 99.69 | 99.69 | +0.00 [-0.52, +0.52] | 99.32 | -0.36 [-1.04, +0.16] |
| AIME26 | 97.19 | 97.50 | +0.31 [-0.52, +1.15] | 96.77 | -0.42 [-1.88, +0.73] |
| GPQA-Diamond | 90.81 | 91.26 | +0.44 [-0.19, +1.10] | 90.74 | -0.08 [-0.84, +0.66] |
| MMMU-Pro (flexible) | 76.82 | 77.02 | +0.20 [-0.52, +0.92] | 76.73 | -0.09 [-0.70, +0.51] |
| MTP acceptance length (AIME25 / GPQA-D) | 2.47 / 2.33 | 2.47 / 2.33 | | 2.46 / 2.32 | |

- All runs had zero request errors, and truncation rates match stock within 0.6 pt.
- Both formats also pass against a larger, earlier stock FP8 reference (32 GPQA-D epochs, 8 MMMU-Pro epochs).
- GSM8K, 200 questions, greedy, thinking off: stock 85.5, MXFP8 85.0, MXFP4 85.5.

### Throughput

`vllm bench serve` with `--dataset-name random --ignore-eos`.
- Server flags: `--max-num-seqs 256 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 --no-enable-prefix-caching`, no speculative decoding.
- `--max-num-batched-tokens`: 16384 for prefill, 8192 for decode.
- Each engine was measured alone; every point was run twice, and the two runs differed by ≤3% (mostly ≤0.3%).

Prefill: TP1 on one GPU, 1 output token. Stock is `--tensor-parallel-size 1`; MegaMoE adds `--enable-expert-parallel --kernel-config '{"moe_backend":"deep_gemm_mega_moe"}'` (and `--quantization-config '{"moe":"mxfp4"}'`).

| Prompt | Stock tok/s | MXFP8 tok/s | MXFP4 tok/s | Mean TTFT stock / MXFP8 / MXFP4 (ms) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 8192 x 256 prompts, concurrency 64 | 45,188 | 51,009 (+12.9%) | 52,441 (+16.1%) | 10,239 / 9,060 / 8,812 |
| 32768 x 64 prompts, concurrency 16 | 43,252 | 48,633 (+12.4%) | 49,865 (+15.3%) | 10,749 / 9,548 / 9,312 |

Decode: DP4 + EP on 4 GPUs, 2048 in / 1024 out, 2x concurrency prompts. Stock uses the default MoE backend with the default all2all.

| Concurrency | Stock out tok/s | MXFP8 | MXFP4 | Mean TPOT stock / MXFP8 / MXFP4 (ms) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 128 | 8,348 | 9,456 (+13.3%) | 10,447 (+25.1%) | 14.15 / 12.65 / 11.39 |
| 256 | 12,453 | 14,045 (+12.8%) | 15,269 (+22.6%) | 18.86 / 17.00 / 15.46 |
| 512 | 17,268 | 20,123 (+16.5%) | 21,356 (+23.7%) | 26.80 / 23.35 / 21.88 |

Weight loading (`Loading weights took`), with four engines starting together on one node:

| Engine | Stock | MXFP8 | MXFP4 |
|---|---|---|---|
| TP1 | 58 s | 67 s | 72 s |
| DP4 (per rank) | 31 s | 28 s | 32 s |

### GPU sync check

`VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK=warn` was set on a TP1 MegaMoE MXFP4 engine with MTP3 (drafter MXFP8), which served 256 requests (2048 in / 256 out, concurrency 32, 0 failed). Prefill steps run the MoE block eagerly. After startup, no synchronizing CUDA operation was reported.

## Details

**Requantization.** MegaMoE takes MX, NVFP4 or BF16 experts, not 128x128 block FP8 with FP32 scales.
- Each EP rank keeps only the experts it owns and stages each shard on the GPU as it arrives.
- Once a projection's owned experts have arrived, the rank requantizes them in a few batched calls, using DeepGEMM's `per_token_cast_to_fp8` / `per_token_cast_to_fp4` with UE8M0 scales over 1x32 groups. MXFP8 is exact whenever a block scale is a power of two.
- Shards are written through each parameter's own `weight_loader`. This is what lets layerwise reload (`reload_weights`, NCCL/IPC weight transfer) buffer and replay the writes into the original storage.
- Chunked updates can split an expert's weight from its scale. The end of each `load_weights` call keeps such half pairs for the next call. A pair still incomplete after loading fails in `process_weights_after_loading`, through a small `QuantizeMethodBase`, the same pattern as `Step5MegaMoEExperts`.

**Format selection.** There is no new flag: the existing online-quantization config chooses the format.
- `moe: mxfp4` or `mxfp8` picks the format, and `ignore`/`targets` patterns apply per layer.
- Requantized layers show up in the online quantization summary.
- The MTP drafter's config does not carry `--quantization-config`, so the drafter's experts stay MXFP8.

**Shared expert.** Qwen4Exp gates the shared expert per token with `sigmoid(shared_expert_gate(x))`. MegaMoE's fused shared expert has no such gate, so the shared expert stays unfused.
- It runs on an auxiliary stream while the router and top-k run, and it joins before the MegaMoE launch, which needs every SM.
- `VLLM_DISABLE_SHARED_EXPERTS_STREAM` turns the overlap off.
- The gated output is added to the routed output in the same order as the default path.

**Other changes.**
- The DeepGEMM MegaMoE warmup now covers Qwen4Exp blocks, and its cache key includes the routed-expert format.
- Docs: a re-quantization table row and example in `docs/features/quantization/online.md`.
- CI: a new B200 step (`qwen4-exp-mega-moe-b200`) runs the tests. They are not added to the H200 Qwen4 Exp job, where the SM100 kernel test would be skipped.

**Limitations.**
- TP>1 is rejected: it needs sequence-parallel inputs on the HC path. Use DP+EP instead.
- Only 128x128 block-FP8 checkpoints are supported; experts the checkpoint leaves unquantized fail with an explicit error.
- NVFP4 is not wired up. At Qwen4Exp's intermediate size (640, not a multiple of 256) the pinned DeepGEMM `nvfp4_mega_moe` kernel desynchronizes its two-tile stages: the TMA warps issue `ceil(640 / 256) = 3` stages per L2 task and the MMA warp consumes `floor = 2`. Large launches hang and small ones return wrong output. That needs a DeepGEMM fix first.
- EPLB plumbing comes from `DeepGemmMegaMoEExperts` but was not exercised here.

**Size.**
- `vllm/models/qwen4_exp/nvidia/mega_moe.py` is ~340 lines and model-local: requantization, loader and block.
- Elsewhere: +13 lines in `model.py`, +4 in `mtp.py`, +13 in the warmup.
- No changes to the generic MegaMoE layer, the scheduler or the model runner.

+or to MXFP4 through ``--quantization-config``. The MTP drafter's config does not
+carry it, so its experts stay MXFP8. The sigmoid-gated shared expert stays
+unfused and runs on an aux stream next to the router.

+

+from torch import nn

+# one projection batches every routed expert.

+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    weight_scale_inv: torch.Tensor,
+    weight_format: MegaMoEWeightFormat,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Requantize ``[N, K]`` block-FP8 weights to MXFP8 or MXFP4.
+
+    Rounds as DeepGEMM's ``per_token_cast_to_fp8`` / ``per_token_cast_to_fp4``
+    and returns the scales as ``[N, K // 32]`` UE8M0 exponents. Rows are
+    independent, so experts may be stacked along dim 0.
+    """
+    rows, cols = weight.shape
+    cast = (
+        "per_token_cast_to_fp4"
+        if weight_format is MEGA_MOE_MXFP4
+        else "per_token_cast_to_fp8"
+    )
+    cast = getattr(import_module(f"{_import_deep_gemm().__name__}.utils"), cast)
+    scale = weight_scale_inv.float()
+    scale = scale.repeat_interleave(rows // scale.shape[0], 0)
+    scale = scale.repeat_interleave(cols // scale.shape[1], 1)
+    values, sf = cast(weight.float() * scale, use_ue8m0=True, gran_k=_MX_GROUP)
+    # Power-of-two FP32 scales: the exponent bits are the UE8M0 value.
+    return values, (sf.view(torch.int32) >> 23).to(torch.uint8)
+
+
+def mega_moe_weight_format(vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str) -> MegaMoEWeightFormat:
+    """MXFP8 unless ``--quantization-config`` resolves MXFP4 for ``prefix``."""
+    quant_config = vllm_config.quant_config
+    if not (
+        isinstance(quant_config, Fp8Config)
+        and quant_config.weight_block_size == [128, 128]
+    ):
+        name = None if quant_config is None else quant_config.get_name()
+        raise NotImplementedError(
+            "Qwen4Exp MegaMoE requires a 128x128 block-FP8 checkpoint; "
+            f"got quantization {name!r}."
+        )
+    if is_layer_skipped(
+        prefix,
+        quant_config.ignored_layers,
+        fused_mapping=quant_config.packed_modules_mapping,
+        match_mode=quant_config.ignored_layers_match_mode,
+    ):
+        raise NotImplementedError(
+            f"Qwen4Exp MegaMoE requires block-FP8 experts; the checkpoint leaves "
+            f"{prefix} unquantized."
+        )
+    online_config = quant_config.online_quantization_config
+    if online_config is None:
+        return MEGA_MOE_MXFP8
+    resolved = online_config.resolve_quant_method_cls(RoutedExperts, prefix)
+    if resolved is None:
+        return MEGA_MOE_MXFP8
+    source, quant_key_str, target_pattern, spec, _ = resolved
+    if spec.weight == kMxfp4Static:
+        weight_format = MEGA_MOE_MXFP4
+    elif spec.weight == kMxfp8Dynamic:
+        weight_format = MEGA_MOE_MXFP8
+    else:
+        raise NotImplementedError(
+            f"Qwen4Exp MegaMoE runs routed experts as mxfp8 or mxfp4; "
+            f"quantization_config asks for {quant_key_str} at {prefix}."
+        )

+        source.value,
+        quant_key_str,
+        target_pattern,
+    )
+    return weight_format

+    """Requantize the complete expert shards buffered by ``load_weights``.
+
+    Half pairs stay buffered: a chunked weight update may pass an expert's
+    weight and its scale in different calls.
+    """
+    for module in model.modules():
+        if isinstance(module, Qwen4ExpMegaMoEExperts):
+            module.flush_requantize()
+
+
+class _FinishRequantize(QuantizeMethodBase):
+    """Flushes the experts; fails on shards missing their weight or scale."""
+
+    requires_device_loading = False
+    supports_pre_processed_weights = True
+
+    def create_weights(self, layer: nn.Module, *args, **kwargs) -> None:
+        raise NotImplementedError("MegaMoE experts allocate weights at construction")
+
+    def apply(self, layer: nn.Module, *args, **kwargs) -> torch.Tensor:
+        raise NotImplementedError("MegaMoE experts run through their forward")
+
+    def process_weights_after_loading(self, layer: nn.Module) -> None:
+        assert isinstance(layer, Qwen4ExpMegaMoEExperts)
+        layer.flush_requantize(strict=True)
+

+class Qwen4ExpMegaMoEExperts(DeepGemmMegaMoEExperts):
+    """MegaMoE experts loaded from per-expert block-FP8 checkpoint tensors.
+
+    Each EP rank buffers the complete (weight, scale) pairs of its own experts
+    and requantizes them per projection in a few batched calls.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, vllm_config: VllmConfig, **kwargs) -> None:
+        super().__init__(vllm_config, activation=MegaMoEActivation(), **kwargs)
+        self.quant_method = _FinishRequantize()
+        # Parameters may sit on meta (weight-cache IPC loading, layerwise
+        # reload), so stage and requantize on the current GPU.
+        self._requantize_device = torch.device(
+            current_platform.device_type, torch.accelerator.current_device_index()
+        )
+        self._pending_shards: dict[tuple[int, str], dict[str, torch.Tensor]] = {}
+        # Complete (expert, weight, block scale) shards per shard id.
+        self._ready_shards: dict[str, list[tuple[int, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]]] = {}
+        # Logical experts this rank holds (redundant replicas share one).
+        self._num_owned_experts = len(
+            {
+                p % self.num_logical_experts
+                for p in range(self.experts_start_idx, self.experts_end_idx)
+            }
+        )
+
+    def load_weights(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> set[str]:
+        """Load ``{expert}.{gate,up,down}_proj.{weight,weight_scale_inv}``."""
+        loaded: set[str] = set()
+        for name, tensor in weights:
+            expert, proj, kind = name.split(".")
+            expert_id, shard_id = int(expert), _CHECKPOINT_SHARDS[proj]
+            prefix = "w2" if shard_id == "w2" else "w13"
+            loaded.update((f"{prefix}_weight", f"{prefix}_weight_scale"))
+            if not self._map_global_expert_id(expert_id):
+                continue
+            pending = self._pending_shards.setdefault((expert_id, shard_id), {})
+            # Stage on the GPU as it arrives: no CPU-side torch ops, which stall
+            # when several engines load on one host.
+            pending[kind] = tensor.to(self._requantize_device)
+            if len(pending) < 2:
+                continue
+            del self._pending_shards[(expert_id, shard_id)]
+            ready = self._ready_shards.setdefault(shard_id, [])
+            ready.append((expert_id, pending["weight"], pending["weight_scale_inv"]))
+            if len(ready) == self._num_owned_experts:
+                self._requantize_ready(shard_id)
+        return loaded
+
+    def flush_requantize(self, strict: bool = False) -> None:
+        for shard_id in list(self._ready_shards):
+            self._requantize_ready(shard_id)
+        if strict and self._pending_shards:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"{self.prefix}: expert shards without both weight and scale: "
+                f"{sorted(self._pending_shards)[:4]}"
+            )
+
+    def _requantize_ready(self, shard_id: str) -> None:
+        ready = self._ready_shards.pop(shard_id)
+        rows = ready[0][1].shape[0]
+        if any(w.shape != ready[0][1].shape for _, w, _ in ready):
+            raise ValueError(f"{self.prefix}: {shard_id} shards differ in shape.")
+        prefix = "w2" if shard_id == "w2" else "w13"
+        chunk = max(1, _REQUANTIZE_CHUNK_ELEMENTS // ready[0][1].numel())
+        for start in range(0, len(ready), chunk):
+            batch = ready[start : start + chunk]
+            weight, scale = requantize_fp8_block(
+                torch.cat([w for _, w, _ in batch]),
+                torch.cat([s for _, _, s in batch]),
+                self.weight_format,
+            )
+            for i, (expert_id, _, _) in enumerate(batch):
+                for suffix, value in (("weight", weight), ("weight_scale", scale)):
+                    param_name = f"{prefix}_{suffix}"
+                    # The parameter's own loader: layerwise reload wraps it.
+                    param = getattr(self, param_name)
+                    param.weight_loader(
+                        param,
+                        value[i * rows : (i + 1) * rows],
+                        param_name,
+                        shard_id=shard_id,
+                        expert_id=expert_id,
+                    )

+    and returns the scales as ``[N, K // 32]`` UE8M0 exponents. Rows are
+    independent, so experts may be stacked along dim 0.
+    """
+    rows, cols = weight.shape
+    cast = (
+        "per_token_cast_to_fp4"
+        if weight_format is MEGA_MOE_MXFP4
+        else "per_token_cast_to_fp8"
+    )
+    cast = getattr(import_module(f"{_import_deep_gemm().__name__}.utils"), cast)
+    scale = weight_scale_inv.float()
+    scale = scale.repeat_interleave(rows // scale.shape[0], 0)
+    scale = scale.repeat_interleave(cols // scale.shape[1], 1)
+    values, sf = cast(weight.float() * scale, use_ue8m0=True, gran_k=_MX_GROUP)
+    # Power-of-two FP32 scales: the exponent bits are the UE8M0 value.
+    return values, (sf.view(torch.int32) >> 23).to(torch.uint8)
+
+
+def mega_moe_weight_format(vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str) -> MegaMoEWeightFormat:
+    """MXFP8 unless ``--quantization-config`` resolves MXFP4 for ``prefix``."""
+    quant_config = vllm_config.quant_config
+    if not (
+        isinstance(quant_config, Fp8Config)
+        and quant_config.weight_block_size == [128, 128]
+    ):
+        name = None if quant_config is None else quant_config.get_name()
+        raise NotImplementedError(
+            "Qwen4Exp MegaMoE requires a 128x128 block-FP8 checkpoint; "
+            f"got quantization {name!r}."
+        )
+    if is_layer_skipped(
+        prefix,
+        quant_config.ignored_layers,
+        fused_mapping=quant_config.packed_modules_mapping,
+        match_mode=quant_config.ignored_layers_match_mode,
+    ):
+        raise NotImplementedError(
+            f"Qwen4Exp MegaMoE requires block-FP8 experts; the checkpoint leaves "
+            f"{prefix} unquantized."
+        )
+    online_config = quant_config.online_quantization_config
+    if online_config is None:
+        return MEGA_MOE_MXFP8
+    resolved = online_config.resolve_quant_method_cls(RoutedExperts, prefix)
+    if resolved is None:
+        return MEGA_MOE_MXFP8
+    source, quant_key_str, target_pattern, spec, _ = resolved
+    if spec.weight == kMxfp4Static:
+        weight_format = MEGA_MOE_MXFP4
+    elif spec.weight == kMxfp8Dynamic:
+        weight_format = MEGA_MOE_MXFP8
+    else:
+        raise NotImplementedError(
+            f"Qwen4Exp MegaMoE runs routed experts as mxfp8 or mxfp4; "
+            f"quantization_config asks for {quant_key_str} at {prefix}."
+        )
+    # Counted in the online quantization summary like a requantized layer.
+    online_config.quantized_layers[prefix] = (
+        source.value,
+        quant_key_str,
+        target_pattern,
+    )
+    return weight_format
+
+
+def flush_mega_moe_requantize(model: nn.Module) -> None:
+    """Requantize the complete expert shards buffered by ``load_weights``.
+
+    Half pairs stay buffered: a chunked weight update may pass an expert's
+    weight and its scale in different calls.
+    """
+    for module in model.modules():
+        if isinstance(module, Qwen4ExpMegaMoEExperts):
+            module.flush_requantize()
+
+
+class _FinishRequantize(QuantizeMethodBase):
+    """Flushes the experts; fails on shards missing their weight or scale."""
+
+    requires_device_loading = False
+    supports_pre_processed_weights = True
+
+    def create_weights(self, layer: nn.Module, *args, **kwargs) -> None:
+        raise NotImplementedError("MegaMoE experts allocate weights at construction")
+
+    def apply(self, layer: nn.Module, *args, **kwargs) -> torch.Tensor:
+        raise NotImplementedError("MegaMoE experts run through their forward")
+
+    def process_weights_after_loading(self, layer: nn.Module) -> None:
+        assert isinstance(layer, Qwen4ExpMegaMoEExperts)
+        layer.flush_requantize(strict=True)
+
+
+class Qwen4ExpMegaMoEExperts(DeepGemmMegaMoEExperts):
+    """MegaMoE experts loaded from per-expert block-FP8 checkpoint tensors.
+
+    Each EP rank buffers the complete (weight, scale) pairs of its own experts
+    and requantizes them per projection in a few batched calls.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, vllm_config: VllmConfig, **kwargs) -> None:
+        super().__init__(vllm_config, activation=MegaMoEActivation(), **kwargs)
+        self.quant_method = _FinishRequantize()
+        # Parameters may sit on meta (weight-cache IPC loading, layerwise
+        # reload), so stage and requantize on the current GPU.
+        self._requantize_device = torch.device(
+            current_platform.device_type, torch.accelerator.current_device_index()
+        )
+        self._pending_shards: dict[tuple[int, str], dict[str, torch.Tensor]] = {}
+        # Complete (expert, weight, block scale) shards per shard id.
+        self._ready_shards: dict[str, list[tuple[int, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]]] = {}
+        # Logical experts this rank holds (redundant replicas share one).
+        self._num_owned_experts = len(
+            {
+                p % self.num_logical_experts
+                for p in range(self.experts_start_idx, self.experts_end_idx)
+            }
+        )
+
+    def load_weights(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> set[str]:
+        """Load ``{expert}.{gate,up,down}_proj.{weight,weight_scale_inv}``."""
+        loaded: set[str] = set()
+        for name, tensor in weights:
+            expert, proj, kind = name.split(".")
+            expert_id, shard_id = int(expert), _CHECKPOINT_SHARDS[proj]
+            prefix = "w2" if shard_id == "w2" else "w13"
+            loaded.update((f"{prefix}_weight", f"{prefix}_weight_scale"))
+            if not self._map_global_expert_id(expert_id):
+                continue
+            pending = self._pending_shards.setdefault((expert_id, shard_id), {})
+            # Stage on the GPU as it arrives: no CPU-side torch ops, which stall
+            # when several engines load on one host.
+            pending[kind] = tensor.to(self._requantize_device)
+            if len(pending) < 2:
+                continue
+            del self._pending_shards[(expert_id, shard_id)]
+            ready = self._ready_shards.setdefault(shard_id, [])
+            ready.append((expert_id, pending["weight"], pending["weight_scale_inv"]))
+            if len(ready) == self._num_owned_experts:
+                self._requantize_ready(shard_id)
+        return loaded
+
+    def flush_requantize(self, strict: bool = False) -> None:
+        for shard_id in list(self._ready_shards):
+            self._requantize_ready(shard_id)
+        if strict and self._pending_shards:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"{self.prefix}: expert shards without both weight and scale: "
+                f"{sorted(self._pending_shards)[:4]}"
+            )
+
+    def _requantize_ready(self, shard_id: str) -> None:
+        ready = self._ready_shards.pop(shard_id)
+        rows = ready[0][1].shape[0]
+        if any(w.shape != ready[0][1].shape for _, w, _ in ready):
+            raise ValueError(f"{self.prefix}: {shard_id} shards differ in shape.")
+        prefix = "w2" if shard_id == "w2" else "w13"
+        chunk = max(1, _REQUANTIZE_CHUNK_ELEMENTS // ready[0][1].numel())
+        for start in range(0, len(ready), chunk):
+            batch = ready[start : start + chunk]
+            weight, scale = requantize_fp8_block(
+                torch.cat([w for _, w, _ in batch]),
+                torch.cat([s for _, _, s in batch]),
+                self.weight_format,
+            )
+            for i, (expert_id, _, _) in enumerate(batch):
+                for suffix, value in (("weight", weight), ("weight_scale", scale)):
+                    param_name = f"{prefix}_{suffix}"
+                    # The parameter's own loader: layerwise reload wraps it.
+                    param = getattr(self, param_name)
+                    param.weight_loader(
+                        param,
+                        value[i * rows : (i + 1) * rows],
+                        param_name,
+                        shard_id=shard_id,
+                        expert_id=expert_id,
+                    )
+
+

detail.body:
## Overview

Runs Qwen4Exp (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next) routed experts on the DeepGEMM MegaMoE backend (`--kernel-config '{"moe_backend":"deep_gemm_mega_moe"}'`, built on `DeepGemmMegaMoEExperts` from #61538). The 128x128 block-FP8 experts of the official checkpoint are requantized at load time to MXFP8 (default) or MXFP4 (`--quantization-config '{"moe":"mxfp4"}'`).

## Claims

- Qwen4Exp can serve with `deep_gemm_mega_moe` on Blackwell with expert parallelism (TP=1; scale out with DP).
- Accuracy: MXFP8 and MXFP4 MegaMoE both pass non-inferiority against stock FP8 on AIME25, AIME26, GPQA-Diamond and MMMU-Pro on the same vLLM commit (table below).
- B300, vs the default MoE backend on the same commit:
  - TP1 prefill throughput: +12-13% (MXFP8), +15-16% (MXFP4).
  - DEP4 decode output throughput: +13-17% (MXFP8), +23-25% (MXFP4); mean TPOT -10-13% / -18-20%.
- Weight loading: requantization adds ~10 s on a TP1 engine (58 s stock vs 67 s MXFP8 / 72 s MXFP4).
- Works with layerwise reload and chunked weight updates.

## Validation

All runs: 8x B300 SXM6 nodes, vLLM nightly `edad8b03c5` plus this patch. Checkpoint: `Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8`. A later cleanup removed comments, unreachable branches and redundant tests without changing numerics, and the unit tests were re-run on it. The branch is now rebased onto `f81a414fae`; the upstream changes in between that touch these files move EPLB replica mapping into MegaMoE staging (only active with EPLB) and change fused-shared-expert selection for the default Qwen4Exp MoE block.

### Unit tests

`pytest tests/models/qwen4_exp/test_mega_moe.py`: 10 passed (~60 s) on B300. The tests cover:
- format selection from `quantization_config`, including `ignore` and `targets`;
- requantization matching DeepGEMM's own casts;
- loading into the kernel layout on one EP rank of two, batched requantization bitwise equal to per-expert requantization;
- weight and scale arriving in separate `load_weights` calls, and the strict post-load check on an incomplete pair;
- layerwise reload replacing the experts in the original storage;
- MXFP8 and MXFP4 experts end-to-end through the MegaMoE kernel against a dequantized reference.

### Accuracy

Reasoning evals with thinking on, sampling `temperature=1.0, top_p=0.95, top_k=20`, `max_tokens=98304`, `--max-model-len 131072 --max-num-batched-tokens 8192`, real MTP3 speculative decoding (`--speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":3}'`).

Epochs per question:

| Benchmark | Epochs | MXFP4 epochs (two pooled runs) |
|---|---|---|
| AIME25 | 32 | 64 |
| AIME26 | 32 | 32 |
| GPQA-Diamond | 16 | 32 |
| MMMU-Pro | 4 | 8 |

Arms:
- Stock FP8: TP4 + EP, default MoE backend.
- MegaMoE: DP4 + EP.

Rule: paired difference vs stock over questions with a bootstrap 95% CI. The result is non-inferior if the CI lower bound is ≥ -2 pt (AIME) or -1 pt (GPQA-D, MMMU-Pro).

| Benchmark | Stock FP8 | MegaMoE MXFP8 | Δ vs stock [95% CI] | MegaMoE MXFP4 | Δ vs stock [95% CI] |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AIME25 | 99.69 | 99.69 | +0.00 [-0.52, +0.52] | 99.32 | -0.36 [-1.04, +0.16] |
| AIME26 | 97.19 | 97.50 | +0.31 [-0.52, +1.15] | 96.77 | -0.42 [-1.88, +0.73] |
| GPQA-Diamond | 90.81 | 91.26 | +0.44 [-0.19, +1.10] | 90.74 | -0.08 [-0.84, +0.66] |
| MMMU-Pro (flexible) | 76.82 | 77.02 | +0.20 [-0.52, +0.92] | 76.73 | -0.09 [-0.70, +0.51] |
| MTP acceptance length (AIME25 / GPQA-D) | 2.47 / 2.33 | 2.47 / 2.33 | | 2.46 / 2.32 | |

- All runs had zero request errors, and truncation rates match stock within 0.6 pt.
- Both formats also pass against a larger, earlier stock FP8 reference (32 GPQA-D epochs, 8 MMMU-Pro epochs).
- GSM8K, 200 questions, greedy, thinking off: stock 85.5, MXFP8 85.0, MXFP4 85.5.

### Throughput

`vllm bench serve` with `--dataset-name random --ignore-eos`.
- Server flags: `--max-num-seqs 256 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 --no-enable-prefix-caching`, no speculative decoding.
- `--max-num-batched-tokens`: 16384 for prefill, 8192 for decode.
- Each engine was measured alone; every point was run twice, and the two runs differed by ≤3% (mostly ≤0.3%).

Prefill: TP1 on one GPU, 1 output token. Stock is `--tensor-parallel-size 1`; MegaMoE adds `--enable-expert-parallel --kernel-config '{"moe_backend":"deep_gemm_mega_moe"}'` (and `--quantization-config '{"moe":"mxfp4"}'`).

| Prompt | Stock tok/s | MXFP8 tok/s | MXFP4 tok/s | Mean TTFT stock / MXFP8 / MXFP4 (ms) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 8192 x 256 prompts, concurrency 64 | 45,188 | 51,009 (+12.9%) | 52,441 (+16.1%) | 10,239 / 9,060 / 8,812 |
| 32768 x 64 prompts, concurrency 16 | 43,252 | 48,633 (+12.4%) | 49,865 (+15.3%) | 10,749 / 9,548 / 9,312 |

Decode: DP4 + EP on 4 GPUs, 2048 in / 1024 out, 2x concurrency prompts. Stock uses the default MoE backend with the default all2all.

| Concurrency | Stock out tok/s | MXFP8 | MXFP4 | Mean TPOT stock / MXFP8 / MXFP4 (ms) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 128 | 8,348 | 9,456 (+13.3%) | 10,447 (+25.1%) | 14.15 / 12.65 / 11.39 |
| 256 | 12,453 | 14,045 (+12.8%) | 15,269 (+22.6%) | 18.86 / 17.00 / 15.46 |
| 512 | 17,268 | 20,123 (+16.5%) | 21,356 (+23.7%) | 26.80 / 23.35 / 21.88 |

Weight loading (`Loading weights took`), with four engines starting together on one node:

| Engine | Stock | MXFP8 | MXFP4 |
|---|---|---|---|
| TP1 | 58 s | 67 s | 72 s |
| DP4 (per rank) | 31 s | 28 s | 32 s |

### GPU sync check

`VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK=warn` was set on a TP1 MegaMoE MXFP4 engine with MTP3 (drafter MXFP8), which served 256 requests (2048 in / 256 out, concurrency 32, 0 failed). Prefill steps run the MoE block eagerly. After startup, no synchronizing CUDA operation was reported.

## Details

**Requantization.** MegaMoE takes MX, NVFP4 or BF16 experts, not 128x128 block FP8 with FP32 scales.
- Each EP rank keeps only the experts it owns and stages each shard on the GPU as it arrives.
- Once a projection's owned experts have arrived, the rank requantizes them in a few batched calls, using DeepGEMM's `per_token_cast_to_fp8` / `per_token_cast_to_fp4` with UE8M0 scales over 1x32 groups. MXFP8 is exact whenever a block scale is a power of two.
- Shards are written through each parameter's own `weight_loader`. This is what lets layerwise reload (`reload_weights`, NCCL/IPC weight transfer) buffer and replay the writes into the original storage.
- Chunked updates can split an expert's weight from its scale. The end of each `load_weights` call keeps such half pairs for the next call. A pair still incomplete after loading fails in `process_weights_after_loading`, through a small `QuantizeMethodBase`, the same pattern as `Step5MegaMoEExperts`.

**Format selection.** There is no new flag: the existing online-quantization config chooses the format.
- `moe: mxfp4` or `mxfp8` picks the format, and `ignore`/`targets` patterns apply per layer.
- Requantized layers show up in the online quantization summary.
- The MTP drafter's config does not carry `--quantization-config`, so the drafter's experts stay MXFP8.

**Shared expert.** Qwen4Exp gates the shared expert per token with `sigmoid(shared_expert_gate(x))`. MegaMoE's fused shared expert has no such gate, so the shared expert stays unfused.
- It runs on an auxiliary stream while the router and top-k run, and it joins before the MegaMoE launch, which needs every SM.
- `VLLM_DISABLE_SHARED_EXPERTS_STREAM` turns the overlap off.
- The gated output is added to the routed output in the same order as the default path.

**Other changes.**
- The DeepGEMM MegaMoE warmup now covers Qwen4Exp blocks, and its cache key includes the routed-expert format.
- Docs: a re-quantization table row and example in `docs/features/quantization/online.md`.
- CI: a new B200 step (`qwen4-exp-mega-moe-b200`) runs the tests. They are not added to the H200 Qwen4 Exp job, where the SM100 kernel test would be skipped.

**Limitations.**
- TP>1 is rejected: it needs sequence-parallel inputs on the HC path. Use DP+EP instead.
- Only 128x128 block-FP8 checkpoints are supported; experts the checkpoint leaves unquantized fail with an explicit error.
- NVFP4 is not wired up. At Qwen4Exp's intermediate size (640, not a multiple of 256) the pinned DeepGEMM `nvfp4_mega_moe` kernel desynchronizes its two-tile stages: the TMA warps issue `ceil(640 / 256) = 3` stages per L2 task and the MMA warp consumes `floor = 2`. Large launches hang and small ones return wrong output. That needs a DeepGEMM fix first.
- EPLB plumbing comes from `DeepGemmMegaMoEExperts` but was not exercised here.

**Size.**
- `vllm/models/qwen4_exp/nvidia/mega_moe.py` is ~340 lines and model-local: requantization, loader and block.
- Elsewhere: +13 lines in `model.py`, +4 in `mtp.py`, +13 in the warmup.
- No changes to the generic MegaMoE layer, the scheduler or the model runner.

+"""Correctness tests for Qwen4Exp block-FP8 experts requantized for MegaMoE."""

+import torch.nn.functional as F

+from vllm.config.quantization import QuantizationConfigArgs
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.deep_gemm_mega_moe import (
+    MEGA_MOE_MXFP4,
+    MEGA_MOE_MXFP8,
+    DeepGemmMegaMoEExperts,
+    MegaMoEActivation,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.fp8 import Fp8Config
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.online.base import (
+    OnlineQuantizationConfig,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.model_loader.reload import (
+    finalize_layerwise_reload,
+    initialize_layerwise_reload,
+    record_metadata_for_reloading,
+)
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.nvidia.mega_moe import (
+    Qwen4ExpMegaMoEExperts,
+    flush_mega_moe_requantize,
+    mega_moe_weight_format,
+    requantize_fp8_block,
+)
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.utils.deep_gemm import is_deep_gemm_supported
+
+HIDDEN, INTER = 512, 256
+FORMATS = [
+    pytest.param(MEGA_MOE_MXFP8, id="mxfp8"),
+    pytest.param(MEGA_MOE_MXFP4, id="mxfp4"),
+]
+requires_deep_gemm = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not is_deep_gemm_supported(), reason="Requires DeepGEMM"
+)
+
+
+def _block_fp8(rows: int, cols: int, generator):
+    weight = torch.randn(rows, cols, generator=generator).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    scale = torch.rand(rows // 128, cols // 128, generator=generator) * 1e-2 + 1e-3
+    return weight, scale
+
+
+def _dequant_block(weight: torch.Tensor, scale: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    scale = scale.repeat_interleave(128, 0).repeat_interleave(128, 1)
+    return weight.float() * scale.to(weight.device)
+
+
+def _dequant_mx(values: torch.Tensor, exponent: torch.Tensor, fmt) -> torch.Tensor:
+    from vllm.third_party.deep_gemm.utils.math import (
+        cast_back_from_fp4,
+        cast_back_from_fp8,
+    )
+
+    sf = (exponent.to(torch.int32) << 23).view(torch.float32)
+    cast_back = cast_back_from_fp4 if fmt is MEGA_MOE_MXFP4 else cast_back_from_fp8
+    return cast_back(values, sf, gran_k=32)
+
+
+def _quant_config(ignored_layers=None, **online) -> SimpleNamespace:
+    config = Fp8Config(weight_block_size=[128, 128], ignored_layers=ignored_layers)
+    if online:

+            QuantizationConfigArgs(**online)
+        )
+    return SimpleNamespace(quant_config=config)

+"""Qwen4Exp routed experts on DeepGEMM MegaMoE.
+
+Block-FP8 checkpoint experts are requantized as they load, to MXFP8 by default
+or to MXFP4 through ``--quantization-config``. The MTP drafter's config does not
+carry it, so its experts stay MXFP8. The sigmoid-gated shared expert stays
+unfused and runs on an aux stream next to the router.
+"""

+    MEGA_MOE_MXFP4,
+    MEGA_MOE_MXFP8,
+    DeepGemmMegaMoEExperts,
+    MegaMoEActivation,
+    MegaMoEWeightFormat,
+)

+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+# K values per UE8M0 scale of the MX formats.
+_MX_GROUP = 32
+_CHECKPOINT_SHARDS = {"gate_proj": "w1", "up_proj": "w3", "down_proj": "w2"}
+# Bounds the FP32 temporaries of one requantize call to a few GiB: at EP1,
+# one projection batches every routed expert.
+_REQUANTIZE_CHUNK_ELEMENTS = 1 << 27
+
+
+def requantize_fp8_block(
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    weight_scale_inv: torch.Tensor,
+    weight_format: MegaMoEWeightFormat,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Requantize ``[N, K]`` block-FP8 weights to MXFP8 or MXFP4.
+
+    Rounds as DeepGEMM's ``per_token_cast_to_fp8`` / ``per_token_cast_to_fp4``
+    and returns the scales as ``[N, K // 32]`` UE8M0 exponents. Rows are
+    independent, so experts may be stacked along dim 0.
+    """
+    rows, cols = weight.shape
+    cast = (
+        "per_token_cast_to_fp4"
+        if weight_format is MEGA_MOE_MXFP4
+        else "per_token_cast_to_fp8"
+    )
+    cast = getattr(import_module(f"{_import_deep_gemm().__name__}.utils"), cast)
+    scale = weight_scale_inv.float()
+    scale = scale.repeat_interleave(rows // scale.shape[0], 0)
+    scale = scale.repeat_interleave(cols // scale.shape[1], 1)
+    values, sf = cast(weight.float() * scale, use_ue8m0=True, gran_k=_MX_GROUP)
+    # Power-of-two FP32 scales: the exponent bits are the UE8M0 value.
+    return values, (sf.view(torch.int32) >> 23).to(torch.uint8)
+
+
+def mega_moe_weight_format(vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str) -> MegaMoEWeightFormat:
+    """MXFP8 unless ``--quantization-config`` resolves MXFP4 for ``prefix``."""
+    quant_config = vllm_config.quant_config
+    if not (
+        isinstance(quant_config, Fp8Config)
+        and quant_config.weight_block_size == [128, 128]
+    ):
+        name = None if quant_config is None else quant_config.get_name()
+        raise NotImplementedError(
+            "Qwen4Exp MegaMoE requires a 128x128 block-FP8 checkpoint; "
+            f"got quantization {name!r}."
+        )
+    if is_layer_skipped(
+        prefix,
+        quant_config.ignored_layers,
+        fused_mapping=quant_config.packed_modules_mapping,
+        match_mode=quant_config.ignored_layers_match_mode,
+    ):
+        raise NotImplementedError(
+            f"Qwen4Exp MegaMoE requires block-FP8 experts; the checkpoint leaves "
+            f"{prefix} unquantized."
+        )
+    online_config = quant_config.online_quantization_config
+    if online_config is None:
+        return MEGA_MOE_MXFP8
+    resolved = online_config.resolve_quant_method_cls(RoutedExperts, prefix)
+    if resolved is None:
+        return MEGA_MOE_MXFP8
+    source, quant_key_str, target_pattern, spec, _ = resolved
+    if spec.weight == kMxfp4Static:
+        weight_format = MEGA_MOE_MXFP4
+    elif spec.weight == kMxfp8Dynamic:
+        weight_format = MEGA_MOE_MXFP8
+    else:
+        raise NotImplementedError(
+            f"Qwen4Exp MegaMoE runs routed experts as mxfp8 or mxfp4; "
+            f"quantization_config asks for {quant_key_str} at {prefix}."
+        )
+    # Counted in the online quantization summary like a requantized layer.
+    online_config.quantized_layers[prefix] = (
+        source.value,
+        quant_key_str,
+        target_pattern,
+    )
+    return weight_format

+def flush_mega_moe_requantize(model: nn.Module) -> None:
+    """Requantize the complete expert shards buffered by ``load_weights``.
+
+    Half pairs stay buffered: a chunked weight update may pass an expert's
+    weight and its scale in different calls.
+    """
+    for module in model.modules():
+        if isinstance(module, Qwen4ExpMegaMoEExperts):
+            module.flush_requantize()

+
+class _FinishRequantize(QuantizeMethodBase):
+    """Flushes the experts; fails on shards missing their weight or scale."""
+
+    requires_device_loading = False
+    supports_pre_processed_weights = True
+
+    def create_weights(self, layer: nn.Module, *args, **kwargs) -> None:
+        raise NotImplementedError("MegaMoE experts allocate weights at construction")
+
+    def apply(self, layer: nn.Module, *args, **kwargs) -> torch.Tensor:
+        raise NotImplementedError("MegaMoE experts run through their forward")
+
+    def process_weights_after_loading(self, layer: nn.Module) -> None:
+        assert isinstance(layer, Qwen4ExpMegaMoEExperts)
+        layer.flush_requantize(strict=True)
+
+
+class Qwen4ExpMegaMoEExperts(DeepGemmMegaMoEExperts):
+    """MegaMoE experts loaded from per-expert block-FP8 checkpoint tensors.
+
+    Each EP rank buffers the complete (weight, scale) pairs of its own experts
+    and requantizes them per projection in a few batched calls.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, vllm_config: VllmConfig, **kwargs) -> None:
+        super().__init__(vllm_config, activation=MegaMoEActivation(), **kwargs)
+        self.quant_method = _FinishRequantize()
+        # Parameters may sit on meta (weight-cache IPC loading, layerwise
+        # reload), so stage and requantize on the current GPU.
+        self._requantize_device = torch.device(
+            current_platform.device_type, torch.accelerator.current_device_index()
+        )
+        self._pending_shards: dict[tuple[int, str], dict[str, torch.Tensor]] = {}
+        # Complete (expert, weight, block scale) shards per shard id.
+        self._ready_shards: dict[str, list[tuple[int, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]]] = {}
+        # Logical experts this rank holds (redundant replicas share one).
+        self._num_owned_experts = len(
+            {
+                p % self.num_logical_experts
+                for p in range(self.experts_start_idx, self.experts_end_idx)
+            }
+        )
+
+    def load_weights(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> set[str]:
+        """Load ``{expert}.{gate,up,down}_proj.{weight,weight_scale_inv}``."""
+        loaded: set[str] = set()
+        for name, tensor in weights:
+            expert, proj, kind = name.split(".")
+            expert_id, shard_id = int(expert), _CHECKPOINT_SHARDS[proj]
+            prefix = "w2" if shard_id == "w2" else "w13"
+            loaded.update((f"{prefix}_weight", f"{prefix}_weight_scale"))
+            if not self._map_global_expert_id(expert_id):
+                continue
+            pending = self._pending_shards.setdefault((expert_id, shard_id), {})
+            # Stage on the GPU as it arrives: no CPU-side torch ops, which stall
+            # when several engines load on one host.
+            pending[kind] = tensor.to(self._requantize_device)
+            if len(pending) < 2:
+                continue
+            del self._pending_shards[(expert_id, shard_id)]
+            ready = self._ready_shards.setdefault(shard_id, [])
+            ready.append((expert_id, pending["weight"], pending["weight_scale_inv"]))
+            if len(ready) == self._num_owned_experts:
+                self._requantize_ready(shard_id)
+        return loaded
+
+    def flush_requantize(self, strict: bool = False) -> None:
+        for shard_id in list(self._ready_shards):
+            self._requantize_ready(shard_id)

+    scale = weight_scale_inv.float()
+    scale = scale.repeat_interleave(rows // scale.shape[0], 0)
+    scale = scale.repeat_interleave(cols // scale.shape[1], 1)
+    values, sf = cast(weight.float() * scale, use_ue8m0=True, gran_k=_MX_GROUP)
+    # Power-of-two FP32 scales: the exponent bits are the UE8M0 value.
+    return values, (sf.view(torch.int32) >> 23).to(torch.uint8)
+
+
+def mega_moe_weight_format(vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str) -> MegaMoEWeightFormat:
+    """MXFP8 unless ``--quantization-config`` resolves MXFP4 for ``prefix``."""
+    quant_config = vllm_config.quant_config
+    if not (
+        isinstance(quant_config, Fp8Config)
+        and quant_config.weight_block_size == [128, 128]
+    ):
+        name = None if quant_config is None else quant_config.get_name()
+        raise NotImplementedError(
+            "Qwen4Exp MegaMoE requires a 128x128 block-FP8 checkpoint; "
+            f"got quantization {name!r}."
+        )
+    if is_layer_skipped(
+        prefix,
+        quant_config.ignored_layers,
+        fused_mapping=quant_config.packed_modules_mapping,
+        match_mode=quant_config.ignored_layers_match_mode,
+    ):
+        raise NotImplementedError(
+            f"Qwen4Exp MegaMoE requires block-FP8 experts; the checkpoint leaves "
+            f"{prefix} unquantized."
+        )
+    online_config = quant_config.online_quantization_config
+    if online_config is None:
+        return MEGA_MOE_MXFP8
+    resolved = online_config.resolve_quant_method_cls(RoutedExperts, prefix)
+    if resolved is None:
+        return MEGA_MOE_MXFP8
+    source, quant_key_str, target_pattern, spec, _ = resolved
+    if spec.weight == kMxfp4Static:
+        weight_format = MEGA_MOE_MXFP4
+    elif spec.weight == kMxfp8Dynamic:
+        weight_format = MEGA_MOE_MXFP8
+    else:
+        raise NotImplementedError(
+            f"Qwen4Exp MegaMoE runs routed experts as mxfp8 or mxfp4; "
+            f"quantization_config asks for {quant_key_str} at {prefix}."
+        )
+    # Counted in the online quantization summary like a requantized layer.
+    online_config.quantized_layers[prefix] = (
+        source.value,
+        quant_key_str,
+        target_pattern,
+    )
+    return weight_format
+
+
+def flush_mega_moe_requantize(model: nn.Module) -> None:
+    """Requantize the complete expert shards buffered by ``load_weights``.
+
+    Half pairs stay buffered: a chunked weight update may pass an expert's
+    weight and its scale in different calls.
+    """
+    for module in model.modules():
+        if isinstance(module, Qwen4ExpMegaMoEExperts):
+            module.flush_requantize()
+
+
+class _FinishRequantize(QuantizeMethodBase):
+    """Flushes the experts; fails on shards missing their weight or scale."""
+
+    requires_device_loading = False
+    supports_pre_processed_weights = True
+
+    def create_weights(self, layer: nn.Module, *args, **kwargs) -> None:
+        raise NotImplementedError("MegaMoE experts allocate weights at construction")
+
+    def apply(self, layer: nn.Module, *args, **kwargs) -> torch.Tensor:
+        raise NotImplementedError("MegaMoE experts run through their forward")
+
+    def process_weights_after_loading(self, layer: nn.Module) -> None:
+        assert isinstance(layer, Qwen4ExpMegaMoEExperts)
+        layer.flush_requantize(strict=True)
+
+
+class Qwen4ExpMegaMoEExperts(DeepGemmMegaMoEExperts):
+    """MegaMoE experts loaded from per-expert block-FP8 checkpoint tensors.
+
+    Each EP rank buffers the complete (weight, scale) pairs of its own experts
+    and requantizes them per projection in a few batched calls.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, vllm_config: VllmConfig, **kwargs) -> None:
+        super().__init__(vllm_config, activation=MegaMoEActivation(), **kwargs)
+        self.quant_method = _FinishRequantize()
+        # Parameters may sit on meta (weight-cache IPC loading, layerwise
+        # reload), so stage and requantize on the current GPU.
+        self._requantize_device = torch.device(
+            current_platform.device_type, torch.accelerator.current_device_index()
+        )
+        self._pending_shards: dict[tuple[int, str], dict[str, torch.Tensor]] = {}
+        # Complete (expert, weight, block scale) shards per shard id.
+        self._ready_shards: dict[str, list[tuple[int, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]]] = {}
+        # Logical experts this rank holds (redundant replicas share one).
+        self._num_owned_experts = len(
+            {
+                p % self.num_logical_experts
+                for p in range(self.experts_start_idx, self.experts_end_idx)
+            }
+        )
+
+    def load_weights(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> set[str]:
+        """Load ``{expert}.{gate,up,down}_proj.{weight,weight_scale_inv}``."""
+        loaded: set[str] = set()
+        for name, tensor in weights:
+            expert, proj, kind = name.split(".")
+            expert_id, shard_id = int(expert), _CHECKPOINT_SHARDS[proj]
+            prefix = "w2" if shard_id == "w2" else "w13"
+            loaded.update((f"{prefix}_weight", f"{prefix}_weight_scale"))
+            if not self._map_global_expert_id(expert_id):
+                continue
+            pending = self._pending_shards.setdefault((expert_id, shard_id), {})
+            # Stage on the GPU as it arrives: no CPU-side torch ops, which stall
+            # when several engines load on one host.
+            pending[kind] = tensor.to(self._requantize_device)
+            if len(pending) < 2:
+                continue
+            del self._pending_shards[(expert_id, shard_id)]
+            ready = self._ready_shards.setdefault(shard_id, [])
+            ready.append((expert_id, pending["weight"], pending["weight_scale_inv"]))
+            if len(ready) == self._num_owned_experts:
+                self._requantize_ready(shard_id)
+        return loaded
+
+    def flush_requantize(self, strict: bool = False) -> None:
+        for shard_id in list(self._ready_shards):
+            self._requantize_ready(shard_id)
+        if strict and self._pending_shards:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"{self.prefix}: expert shards without both weight and scale: "
+                f"{sorted(self._pending_shards)[:4]}"
+            )
+
+    def _requantize_ready(self, shard_id: str) -> None:
+        ready = self._ready_shards.pop(shard_id)
+        rows = ready[0][1].shape[0]
+        if any(w.shape != ready[0][1].shape for _, w, _ in ready):
+            raise ValueError(f"{self.prefix}: {shard_id} shards differ in shape.")
+        prefix = "w2" if shard_id == "w2" else "w13"
+        chunk = max(1, _REQUANTIZE_CHUNK_ELEMENTS // ready[0][1].numel())
+        for start in range(0, len(ready), chunk):
+            batch = ready[start : start + chunk]
+            weight, scale = requantize_fp8_block(
+                torch.cat([w for _, w, _ in batch]),
+                torch.cat([s for _, _, s in batch]),
+                self.weight_format,
+            )
+            for i, (expert_id, _, _) in enumerate(batch):
+                for suffix, value in (("weight", weight), ("weight_scale", scale)):
+                    param_name = f"{prefix}_{suffix}"
+                    # The parameter's own loader: layerwise reload wraps it.
+                    param = getattr(self, param_name)
+                    param.weight_loader(
+                        param,
+                        value[i * rows : (i + 1) * rows],
+                        param_name,
+                        shard_id=shard_id,
+                        expert_id=expert_id,
+                    )
+
+
+class Qwen4ExpMegaMoeBlock(nn.Module):
